# Panels

Present collection steps in exactly this order. Never reorder, merge or
reassign steps between departments.

## CSF Emergency Panel (`csf_emergency_panel`)

- **Specimen:** Cerebrospinal Fluid (Lumbar puncture)
- **Also called:** csf emergency panel, csf panel, csf workup, csf emergency, csf

| Step | Department | Purpose | Observables |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Tube 1 | Clinical Biochemistry | Primary aliquot for chemical quantification (Protein, Glucose) | CSF protein, CSF glucose |
| Tube 2 | Microbiology | Microbiology culture and gram stain (avoids skin flora contamination) | CSF Gram stain, CSF culture |
| Tube 3 | Hematology | Cell count & differential (cleared of traumatic puncture peripheral blood) | CSF leukocytes, CSF neutrophils |
